title: The Copyright (Amendment) Act, 2026
text:
Legal Supplement Part A to the “Trinidad and Tobago Gazette”, Vol. 65,
No. 16, 12th February, 2026
First Session Thirteenth Parliament Republic of
Trinidad and Tobago
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO
Act No. 3 of 2026
[L.S.]
BILL
AN ACT to amend the Copyright Act, Chap. 82:80 to
extend the duration of the term of protection for
copyright and neighbouring rights for authors,
performers and producers of sound recordings; to
extend the duration of the term of protection for
moral rights for authors and performers; and to
provide for related matters
[Assented to 11th February, 2026]
ENACTED by the Parliament of Trinidad and Tobago as
Enactment
follows:
16 No. 3 Copyright (Amendment) 2026
1. This Act may be cited as the Copyright
Short title
(Amendment) Act, 2026.
2. In this Act, “the Act” means the Copyright Act.
Interpretation
Chap. 82:80
3. Section 19 of the Act is amended in subsections (1)
Section 19
amended and (2) by deleting the word “fifty” and substituting the
word “seventy”.
4. Section 19A of the Act is amended by deleting the
Section 19A
amended words “the fiftieth year in which the performance was
fixed” and substituting the words “a period of seventy
years computed from the end of the year in which the
performance was fixed”.
5. Section 21(4) of the Act is amended by deleting the
Section 21 amended
word “fifty” and substituting the word “seventy”.
6. Section 22 of the Act is amended by repealing
Section 22 amended
subsection (2) and substituting the following subsection:
“(2) The rights under subsection (1) shall be
protected–
(a) from the publication of the sound
recording until the end of a period of
seventy years computed from the end
of the year in which the sound recording
was published; or
(b) if the sound recording has not been
published, from the fixation of the
sound recording until the end of a
period of seventy years computed
from the end of the year in which the
sound recording was fixed.”.
7. Section 23 of the Act is amended by repealing
Section 23 amended
subsection (4) and substituting the following subsection:
“(4) The right to an equitable remuneration
under this section shall subsist from–
(a) the date of publication of the sound
recording until the end of a period of
seventy years computed from the end
of the year in which the sound recording
was published; or
No. 3 Copyright (Amendment) 2026 17
(b) if the sound recording has not been
published, from the date of fixation of
the sound recording until the end of a
period of seventy years computed
from the end of the year in which the
sound recording was fixed.”.
8. Section 24 of the Act is amended in subsection (2)
Section 24 amended
by deleting the words “the fiftieth calendar year
following the year in which the broadcast first takes
place” and substituting the words “a period of fifty years
computed from the end of the year in which the
broadcast first takes place”.
Passed in the Senate this 3rd day of February, 2026.
Clerk of the Senate
Passed in the House of Representatives this 6th day
of February, 2026.
Clerk of the House
